title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
跟着朱标拜访了一下亲近人家，基本上都是开国功臣、未来的大明公侯。虽然这些人基本上都在外打仗，不过见了家眷也可以。文官系统的一个没见，马寻现在就算是大明第一外戚，真正的外戚。在拜访了一些勋贵之后，马寻继续回到了皇宫，生活好像也没其他变化。“小弟，劈的时候要狠、撩的时候要快！”李贞背着手，指导着马寻在练功。马寻收棍，笑着说道，“姐夫，我这都是些庄稼把式，让您看笑话了。”李贞鼓励说道，“防身是够了，就是差了点气势。小弟要是上战场、临敌的时候，下手还要狠一点，你心里头还是有些仁慈。”马寻实事求是的说道，“我这些把式，真要是去了战场就是笑话。”李贞继续安慰，“话也不能这么说，真到了战场都是白刀子进红刀子出。再厉害的功夫也挡不住枪林箭雨，能赢就行。”个人勇武在战场自然有一定的作用，只是除非是项羽、李存孝那样的，要不然很难凭借着一己之力改变战局。马寻在练武的时候，李景隆拿着个小木刀咿咿呀呀的胡乱挥舞，显然这也是个好动的孩子。就在马寻准备投入新一轮的练武之时，朱元璋的声音传来，“俺不来看你们，你们也就不去看看俺们？”李贞连忙说道，“陛下忙，臣等哪能轻易叨扰。”朱元璋就不高兴的说道，“姐夫、小弟，你们都是自家人，哪有那么多礼数，总是处处见外！”马秀英也不高兴的对马寻说道，“到了京城半个月了，你主动去找过俺和你姐夫吗？”马寻也连忙开口，“姐夫和姐都忙，我现在过的好好的，吃喝不愁，还有大姐夫教我武艺，跟着太子读书，用不着姐夫、姐操心。”朱元璋哑然失笑，随即说道，“一个是俺姐夫，一个是俺舅子，你们两个倒是投契，性子都差不多。”李贞深以为然，本来还担心马寻年轻，说不定会像一些年轻人那样张扬。可是没想到这孩子老成稳重，做事也非常规矩，李贞就喜欢这样的人。到了屋里，朱元璋问道，“小弟，可看了你外甥媳妇？你觉得怎么样？”马寻就笑着说道，“这么大的事情，我哪能瞎说。”马秀英果断开口，“你是舅舅，自然能说。说，你觉得那丫头如何？”“我觉得好啊，其他的不说，太子喜欢就行。”马寻就笑着开口说道，“两孩子站一起就跟金童玉女一般，就站那你瞅我一眼、我瞄你一下。”朱元璋和马秀英也都笑了起来，“那两孩子都藏不住事，过两年不成亲都不行了。”

马秀英就笑着说道，“俺那亲家也是厉害人物，当年她跟着常遇春在和县投奔你姐夫。你姐夫那时候不待见常遇春，觉得就是混饭吃的。”马寻凑趣说道，“这我倒是不知，就知道常大将军厉害，纵横天下无敌手。”朱元璋嘲笑说道，“那会儿你没见着老常，看着就是混饭吃的样子，又狂妄的厉害，俺那时候哪能想到他那么大本事！”马秀英也说道，“你姐夫渡江，俺留守和县。那会儿巢湖的人，郭家的人，还有其他投奔来的人，家眷都在，心也不齐。俺唱红脸，常蓝氏唱白脸。”朱元璋也笑着开口，“常蓝氏泼辣，土匪窝子里出来的能不厉害？你姐懒得和一些泼妇计较，就是常蓝氏帮忙出面，那些泼妇在她面前可不敢撒泼。”马寻只是在笑，不过也能够理解，因为老朱的那些班底，很多人的出身确实不怎么高。马秀英就笑着说道，“标儿和常婉同龄，小时候就在一块玩闹。本以为没什么，哪知道后来就觉着不对味了。”马寻好奇问道，“怎么就看出来不对味了？”朱元璋得意洋洋的说道，“你其他几个侄子皮，你大外甥唱红脸、婉儿就唱白脸。就是老五现在都如此，听闻婉儿入宫，他就赶紧去坦白闯的祸。”马寻好像明白了，笑着问道，“那丫头护着老二他们几个？这倒是好，标儿就该管着弟弟妹妹。”马秀英也笑着说道，“就是如此，以前总觉得他们就是小兄弟姐妹在一块玩闹。哪知道标儿和婉儿看对了眼，标儿有个锦囊，绣了个鸳鸯。”马寻不太确定的问道，“不是说女红不太好吗？”马秀英笑着说道，“不好归不好，不是说不会。就是那鸳鸯绣的，跟肥鸭子一般，偏偏标儿就喜欢。”“说什么呢？说什么呢？”朱标脚步匆匆的走进屋，“老远就听到你们在说笑，不是在说我舅舅的亲事吧？”朱元璋打趣说道，“说你比你舅舅有能耐，自己找了个媳妇。你舅舅都二十了，还没个家室，这可如何是好！”吃瓜的马寻立刻觉得大事不妙，这段时间没少被明里暗里的催婚，可是这些事情他哪有头绪啊。朱标坦然的说道，“爹、娘，我觉得宋师家里的倒不错。”“俺知道你亲近宋濂，只是不妥。”朱元璋立刻说道，“宋濂那老匹夫俺不喜欢，你舅舅虽说守礼，只是也不是正经读书人，受不了宋家的丫头。”朱标又建议说道，“那就选宣国公，他是右丞相，也是最早投效的。

I followed Zhu Biao to visit some of the people I was close to, most of whom were the founding heroes and future Dukes of the Ming Dynasty.Although these people are basically fighting outside, it is okay to meet their family members.Not seeing anyone in the civil service system, Ma Xun is now considered the first relative of the Ming Dynasty, a real relative.After visiting some nobles, Ma Xun returned to the palace, and his life seemed to have no other changes."Brother, be hard when you chop, and be fast when you tease!" Li Zhen, holding her hands behind her back, guided Ma Xun in his practice.Ma Xun put away his stick and said with a smile, "Brother-in-law, these are just some tricks of mine. I'm making you laugh." Li Zhen encouraged, "It's enough for self-defense, but it's just a bit lacking in momentum. If I go to the battlefield and face the enemy, I'll be more ruthless. You still have some mercy in your heart." Ma Xun said matter-of-factly, "If I really use these tricks,It's a joke when you're on the battlefield." Li Zhen continued to comfort, "You can't say that.When it comes to the battlefield, white knives go in and red knives come out.No matter how powerful you are, you can't stop the hail of arrows.As long as you can win, personal bravery will certainly play a role, but unless you are like Xiang Yu and Li Cunxiao, it will be difficult to change the situation of the battle on your own.While Ma Xun was practicing martial arts, Li Jinglong was swinging a small wooden knife around wildly. Apparently, he was also an active child.Just when Ma Xun was about to engage in a new round of martial arts training, Zhu Yuanzhang's voice came, "If I don't come to see you, why don't you come to see us?" Li Zhen said quickly, "Your Majesty is busy, how can I disturb you so easily?" Zhu YuanZhang said unhappily, "Brother-in-law and younger brother, you are all members of the same family. How can you have so many etiquettes? You always look out for others!" Ma Xiuying also said to Ma Xun unhappily, "You have been in the capital for half a month, and you have taken the initiative to find me.With your brother-in-law?" Ma Xun also said quickly, "My brother-in-law and sister are busy.I am living a good life now. I don't have to worry about food and drink.My eldest brother-in-law teaches me martial arts and I study with the prince, so I don't need my brother-in-law and sister to worry." Zhu Yuanzhang was speechless.He smiled and then said, "One is my brother-in-law and the other is my uncle-in-law. You two are very compatible and have similar temperaments." Li Zhenshen thought it was true. She was originally worried that Ma Xun was young and might be as flamboyant as some young people.But I didn't expect that this child was mature and stable, and he was very disciplined in doing things. Li Zhen liked people like this.When he arrived at the house, Zhu Yuanzhang asked, "Brother, have you seen your nephew's wife? What do you think?" Ma Xun smiled and said, "How can I talk nonsense about such a big thing." Ma Xiuying said decisively, "You are an uncle, so you can naturally say it. Tell me, what do you think of that girl?" "I think it's good.Don't say anything else, just like it." Ma Xun said with a smile, "The two children are like golden girls standing together.You look at me and I look at you." Zhu Yuanzhang and Ma Xiuying also laughed, "Those two children can't hide anything.They won't get married in two years."

Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "My in-laws are also powerful people. She followed Chang Yuchun to join your brother-in-law in He County. Your brother-in-law didn't want to see Chang Yuchun at that time and thought he was just a living person." Ma Xun said jokingly, "I don't know about this, I just knowGeneral Chang is so powerful that he is invincible in the world." Zhu Yuanzhang said mockingly, "You didn't see Lao Chang at that time.You looked like you were just trying to make ends meet, and you were so arrogant.How could I have imagined that he was so capable?" Ma Xiuying also said, "Your brother-in-law!After crossing the river, I stayed behind in He County.At that time, the people from Chaohu, the Guo family, and other people who had defected were all there, and I was a good person, and Chang Lan was a bad person.Can you be awesome?Your sister is too lazy to argue with some shrews. Even if Chang Lan comes to help, those shrews don't dare to act in front of her."Ma Xun just laughed, but it was understandable, because many of Lao Zhu's team members did not have high backgrounds.Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "Biao'er and Chang Wan are the same age, and they played together when they were young. I thought it was nothing, but later on I felt something was wrong." Ma Xun asked curiously, "Why did you notice something was wrong?" Zhu Yuanzhang said proudly, "For your other nephews, your eldest nephew is the red face, and Wan'er is the white face. That's Lao Wu now.Even so, when he heard that Wan'er had entered the palace, he hurriedly confessed the trouble."Ma Xun seemed to understand and asked with a smile, "It's good that the girl is protecting the second brother and the others.Biao'er should take care of his younger brothers and sisters." Ma Xiuying also said with a smile, "That's it.I always thought that Biao'er and Wan'er were playing together.Biao'er had a trick, and he embroidered a mandarin duck." Ma Xun asked uncertainly, "Isn't it said that the female red is not good?" Ma Xiuying said with a smile, "It's not that it's not good.It's just like a fat duck, but Biao'er likes it." "What are you talking about?" Zhu Biao walked into the house hurriedly.I heard you guys were joking, weren't you talking about my uncle's marriage?" Zhu Yuanzhang joked, "You said you are more capable than your uncle and have found a wife yourself.Your uncle is already twenty and doesn't have a family yet.What should we do?" Ma Xun immediately felt that something was wrong. During this period, he was being urged to get married, but he had no clue about these things.Zhu Biao said calmly, "Father, mother, I think Master Song's family is pretty good." "I know you are close to Song Lian, but it's just inappropriate." Zhu Yuanzhang said immediately, "I don't like that old man Song Lian.Huan, although your uncle is a strict scholar, he is not a serious scholar and can't stand the girls of the Song family." Zhu Biao suggested again, "Then choose Duke Xuan.He is the right prime minister and the first to surrender.
